head: 7f44a537ed98
scope: Retrait des 16 tests hôtes character_removal_* qui pilotaient l'UI retirée, après reprise de chaque comportement par un test propriétaire non visuel.
decision: Décidée par Yoahn le 2026-11-11 : retirer d'abord les 9 tests repris ou purement de mise en page, puis les 7 partiels une fois couverts.

removedFiles.note: Hôte widget de l'atelier Personnages retiré ; plus aucun importeur.

cases.test: dirty owner blocks inspection and keeps focused input
cases.replacement: a dirty draft of the removed character refuses inspection and keeps the draft

cases.test: unrelated dirty map does not block a free character removal
cases.replacement: a dirty map without the character does not block removal and stays dirty

cases.test: affected dirty map refuses removal without saving another owner
cases.replacement: a dirty map that references the character refuses removal and saves nothing

cases.test: free removal preserves an unrelated focused character draft
cases.replacement: a removal drops only the removed draft and keeps another dirty draft

cases.test: dirty replacement is refused without saving its focused draft
cases.replacement: a dirty draft of the replacement refuses the replace resolution and keeps the map reference

cases.test: replacement preserves unrelated undo and rejects deleted NPC
cases.replacement: a replacement keeps the open map history and refuses an undo to the deleted character

cases.test: character removal keeps actions accessible at 1536.0
character removal keeps actions accessible at 1280.0
character removal keeps actions accessible at 1024.0
referenced character is replaced through the real global resolution
cases.replacement: a replace resolution rewrites the reference on disk and in the clean open map

cases.test: clear resolution preserves the map owner and independent data
cases.replacement: a clear resolution empties the reference on disk and in the clean open map

cases.test: reanalyzing requires a new explicit confirmation
cases.replacement: a new inspection revokes the confirmation and deletes nothing until confirmed again

cases.test: character changed after confirmation preparation is not overwritten
cases.replacement: a character changed after the plan was prepared is neither overwritten nor deleted

cases.test: replacement removed after preview cannot partially replace map references
cases.replacement: a replacement deleted after the preview leaves the project and the map untouched

cases.test: published character removal retries UI without replaying delete
cases.replacement: a failed reconciliation after publication keeps the receipt and retries without replaying the deletion

cases.test: free character removal persists without selecting the next identity
cases.replacement: a free removal deletes only the character and selects no other identity

mutationSurvivors.reason: Mutant équivalent : prepare() remet aussi confirmed à faux ; la mutation conjointe confirmation_never_revoked est détectée.

Six couches refusent un plan périmé (Studio lifecycle apply ×2, expectedBefore/SnapshotRevision, plan_store, garde des dépendances de mutation_api, puis une autre non identifiée). Les deux tests de concurrence vérifient la donnée sur disque, mais leur détection par mutation n'est pas démontrée.

reviewer: Aucune revue indépendante ; correspondance établie par l'auteur des tests de remplacement, à partir de red-ui-tests-owner-coverage.json et des mutations.
limits: Les tests visuels de la future UI de suppression restent à écrire en T02+.
